verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a banking-as-a-service API platform, so the story applies. The evidence documents only single-record APIs: customer creation, account management, card issuance, individual internal transfers, wires and ACH, scheduled payments, and webhooks. No batch or bulk endpoint, and no feature for operating across many items at once, appears anywhere in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
